context: Tests that example prompts in rebrand-portal guidance route users into the right workflow: source site required, full demos include assets and collections, frontend-only stops before assets, assets-later includes collections, and vague prompts ask for the missing source site.

checklist.name: Full demo with existing assets
checklist.description: Examples include a full demo prompt with a source site and assets already in Adobe.

check.value: The assets are already in Adobe.

checklist.name: Full demo with sample asset source
checklist.description: Examples include a full demo prompt with a source site and a separate source page for sample assets.

checklist.name: Frontend-only prompt stops before assets
checklist.description: Examples include a prompt that creates the visual/content copy but stops before loading assets.

checklist.name: Assets-later prompt includes collections
checklist.description: Examples include a resumed assets prompt that tells the agent to create collections too.

check.value: Now load Acme's assets from Adobe and create the collections.

checklist.name: Vague prompt asks for source site
checklist.description: Guidance says a vague rebrand prompt should trigger an ask for the required source site.

check.value: I need Acme's source site so I can match the look and content direction.

checklist.name: No internal tool names in README examples
checklist.description: README examples avoid tool names and step ids.
